why: The figures come in pairs: a shape, then the same shape with a smaller copy of itself inside. Circle then circle-in-circle, triangle then triangle-in-triangle, so square must be followed by square-in-square. Option 1 fits. Options 2, 3 and 4 put a different shape inside.
trick: Look for pairs in a long row: shape, then the same shape doubled.
